name: WayriCAD Assistant
description: Use local language commands to run suite checks and open generated reports.
description_full: Local commands or optional loopback Ollama coordinate registered read-only WayriCAD CLI actions. Shows reviewable plans, asks for missing inputs, offers saved-board net selection and explains hash-verified numerical results. No cloud, automatic model downloads or layout edits. LLM proposals require explicit Run; model explanations do not validate engineering results. Existing tool runtimes and numerical limits still apply. Independent KiCad 10 IPC plugin.
